classification: checkpointed batch OCR and field-level multi-pass adjudication repair

source_evidence.observed_failure: The agent repeatedly extracted and printed records for all 22 receipt images, but the fifth complete OCR pass never reached workbook save. Four consecutive polls showed no new progress; the rollout terminated as stuck and /app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx was absent. Offline comparison of the final printed records with the oracle also found three field mismatches, so eventual file creation alone would not have passed.
source_evidence.earliest_functional_error: At trajectory event 9, the agent launched an uncheckpointed full-batch multi-pass OCR procedure and selected one whole-page OCR result by average confidence. Parser revisions then repeated the entire batch instead of reusing observations, and field-specific evidence found during targeted inspection was not carried into final candidate selection.
non_failure_boundaries: the rollout has execution_ok=true and complete protocol evidence
persistent full-body preload of the official Skill bundle is verified
pytesseract and openpyxl were available and working
the agent demonstrated successful OCR over all 22 inputs before the final stuck command
the official verifier stopped at the missing-file assertion; an offline oracle comparison was used only to diagnose the already printed fields and no oracle value is included in the repair

targets.section: Batch Processing Multiple Images / Checkpointed Batch OCR
targets.description_skill_error: The official batch example saves results only after the loop and does not separate OCR acquisition from downstream parsing. It gives no resume cache, selective-retry boundary, or no-progress handling for a long batch.
targets.gold_repair: Inventory inputs deterministically; persist each baseline OCR observation incrementally; revise parsers against cached text; rerun OCR only for evidence-backed difficult images with bounded alternatives; expose completed-file progress; resume from cache after no progress; materialize the requested artifact in a separate short step; require every input and the final artifact to pass explicit completion gates.

targets.description_skill_error: The official multi-pass guidance says to combine results but does not require pass provenance or define field-level conflict resolution. This permits selection of one entire OCR pass by whole-page average confidence even when another pass contains stronger evidence for a target field.
targets.gold_repair: Preserve every bounded retry as a separate provenance-bearing observation; resolve each required field independently using label proximity, task keyword priority, format and range validity, layout context, and cross-pass agreement; use the required null/error representation for unresolved conflicts; verify terminal batch status and the final artifact before completion.

validation.acceptance_boundary: One valid reward-1 fresh rollout with the current completion guard is required before either repair item is accepted as Gold. File creation alone is insufficient; the official verifier must validate all OCR-derived cells.
